rate_limits.correction: Published limits: most endpoints allow 600 requests per 60 seconds in live mode and 100 per 60 seconds in test mode. Live-mode extended limits include 3,000 per 60 seconds for transaction verification and endpoint-specific limits for other critical operations.

notes: The docs URL is current and accessible through normal web retrieval; the automated 403 is consistent with bot filtering rather than a broken URL. Paystack added documented standard and extended API rate limits in June 2026, making the entry's rate-limit claim outdated. No authoritative CORS policy was located.
